analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI is trading sideways in the 30-50 range, showing no directional bias. MACD histogram continues to worsen in negative territory, indicating residual downward pressure. Volume ratio at 0.71 of the 5-day average suggests weakened conviction for trend changes. Weekly ADX at 26.1 indicates a trend, but the lack of clear daily direction warrants continued observation.
